settings.repere: Paragraphe · Is Novaa Red Light Therapy safe and ar…
settings.text: Is Novaa Red Light Therapy safe and are there any side effects?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes, Novaa Red Light Therapy is safe t…
settings.text: Yes, Novaa Red Light Therapy is safe to use at home. Our devices are designed with the highest standards of safety, using medical-grade materials that are durable and non-toxic. Red light therapy is non-invasive and supported by over 3,000 clinical studies validating its safety and effectiveness.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · While there are no known long-term neg…
settings.text: While there are no known long-term negative side effects, here are a few considerations to ensure safe and effective use:

settings.repere: Point · Skin Sensitivity: Some users may exper…
settings.text: Skin Sensitivity: Some users may experience mild redness or irritation, especially with overuse or if they have sensitive skin. To avoid this, follow the recommended session times and instructions.

settings.repere: Point · Skin Dryness or Tightness: If your ski…
settings.text: Skin Dryness or Tightness: If your skin feels dry after a session, applying moisturizer can help.

settings.repere: Point · Temporary Symptoms: Occasionally, user…
settings.text: Temporary Symptoms: Occasionally, users may notice slight redness or mild discomfort as part of the natural healing process.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Safety Tips:
settings.text: Safety Tips:

settings.repere: Point · Use the device as directed, limiting s…
settings.text: Use the device as directed, limiting sessions to 10–20 minutes per area, 3–5 times a week.

settings.repere: Point · Avoid prolonged exposure or placing th…
settings.text: Avoid prolonged exposure or placing the device too close to the skin to prevent overheating.

settings.repere: Point · If you’re pregnant, breastfeeding, tak…
settings.text: If you’re pregnant, breastfeeding, taking photosensitizing medications, or have a history of skin cancer, consult a healthcare provider before starting therapy.
